title: Window B v15 label-free Ag lateral registry candidate geometry screen
created_scope: Geometry generation and audit only; no DFT, MACE inference/training, MD, or TTM was run.
structures_are: New local registries of existing small-cluster motifs. They are not independently sourced morphologies or extended-interface coverage.

hard_screen.exact_duplicate_rule: Same persistent atom IDs and elements, max-cell-component difference <= 1e-5 A, and aligned all-atom RMS <= 1e-5 A.
hard_screen.near_duplicate_rule: Same persistent atom IDs and elements; after minimum-image alignment using the non-Ag framework, Ag-registry RMS <= 0.15 A and non-Ag framework RMS <= 0.15 A.
hard_screen.rms_definition: Cartesian RMS over atoms after matching persistent lammps_id values; source displacement RMS is before any global alignment because only the Ag sublattice is moved.
hard_screen.nearest_neighbor_definition: Minimum-image distances among distinct atoms in the supplied 3D periodic cell; the box is a large-vacuum small-cluster representation.

lateral_translation_screen.selection_rule: Use the largest tested displacement that passes both all-pair and Ag-nonAg 1.75 A cutoffs and exact/near-duplicate checks. If none pass, retain a best-contact proposal for audit but mark it rejected and do not nominate it.
lateral_translation_screen.axes_basis: Follow the explicit lateral-axis convention in pbe_interface_v13_holdouts/prepare_independent_holdouts.py; z is the established interface normal in that workflow.

decision_note: Ag-C has a source-inherited C#604587–Ti#604590 pair below the strict all-atom 1.75 A cutoff. Translation of Ag cannot change it. Its Ag-nonAg registry contacts are reported separately; the proposal is retained as an unlabeled audit artifact and is not nominated under the literal all-pair gate. Window A owns review and any DFT decision.
